source.name: Footy Headlines: 2026 Chinese Super League Kits - All Releases So Far
source.note: Kit supplier for all 16 CSL clubs in 2026, including Shandong Taishan (bespoke home design; the launch render carries no printed sponsors).
source.quote: Nike has officially unveiled the 2026 Home Kits for all 16 teams competing in the Chinese Super League (CSL).

summary: 2026 CSL home kit by Nike (orange, bespoke design). Front sponsor 'First Spring Under Heaven' (天下第一泉, the Jinan scenic-area brand) and back sponsor Jinan Wildlife World, both culture-and-tourism brands tied to club owner Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group, per named press two rounds into the 2026 season. Not complete: the official launch render shows no printed sponsors, and no openable source names sleeve, shorts or league-patch placements; the club's December 2025 sponsor roster (State Grid, Shandong Energy Group, China Green Development, the Yingda trio, Jinan Rail Transit, Jinan Culture & Tourism, Qingdao Bank, FAW-Volkswagen, Baotu Spring Liquor — Sohu, 2025-12-11) gives no shirt placements.
